-- Pure check: a name is plain when it is non-empty and has no
-- path separators, no "..", and is not absolute.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  ex is_plain_name("") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  if name.split("..").len() > 1
    return False
  True

-- Reads one file from the current (already narrowed) fs.
-- Missing or unreadable files give None.
read_text(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  let text = fs.read(name) else return None
  text

-- Returns the text of the first name in `names` that can be read from the
-- `notes` directory, or "" when none can. Names that are not plain
-- are skipped, and missing or unreadable files count as not readable.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if is_plain_name(name)
        let got = read_text(name)
        if got != None
          return (got else "")
  ""
